expectations.text: Refuses to share the live item bank with training partners.
expectations.evidence: 'Live items never go to a training partner.'

expectations.text: Refuses to let training partners proctor or run sittings for their own students, separating teaching from exam delivery.
expectations.evidence: 'Use an independent exam-delivery partner'; training partners 'May not: Proctor'.

expectations.text: Rejects the 40%-per-pass revenue share as a share of passes, and allows a revenue share on exam vouchers sold through trainers instead.
expectations.evidence: 'A revenue share on exam vouchers sold is allowed. A share of passes is not.'

expectations.text: Removes Tomasz, the item writer, from prep-course authoring, stating that item writers never author prep courses.
expectations.evidence: 'Item writers never author prep courses. Tomasz keeps the item bank.'

expectations.text: Keeps the assessed exam off the MOOC platform because its built-in quizzes are unproctored and only the vendor awards the credential.
expectations.evidence: 'Course-platform quizzes are unproctored and only the vendor awards the credential.'

expectations.text: Keeps the award decision with Orvalon even when a delivery partner runs the sitting.
expectations.evidence: Roles table: Orvalon 'Own the bank, the cut score and the award'; delivery partner may not 'decide the award'.

expectations.text: Sets authorisation criteria for each trainer: holds the credential, passes a teach-back session, uses the official blueprint.
expectations.evidence: 'Every teaching trainer holds the credential. Each trainer passes a teach-back session... teaches from the official blueprint only.'

expectations.text: Commits to auditing a sample of training sessions yearly and publishing the authorised partner list.
expectations.evidence: 'Orvalon audits a sample of sessions each year. Orvalon publishes the partner list.'

expectations.text: Names pass guarantees and leaked items as grounds for revoking a training partner's authorisation.
expectations.evidence: 'Orvalon revokes authorisation for pass guarantees or leaked items.'

expectations.text: Lists what prep material may carry: the blueprint, domain weights, retired sample items and practice environments.
expectations.evidence: 'the published blueprint with domain weights, retired sample items, practice environments'.

expectations.text: Contracts exam-delivery partners (test-centre networks or online proctoring services) as processors, with Orvalon keeping the item bank, the cut score and the award decision.
expectations.evidence: 'Run sittings as a contracted processor'; 'Hold the item bank, set the cut score, decide the award' is listed under may not.

expectations.text: States the economics split: training partners earn from course fees, the vendor earns from exam fees or partner-tier fees.
expectations.evidence: 'Training partners earn from course fees. Orvalon earns from exam fees.'

expectations.text: Refuses to share the live item bank with training partners.

expectations.evidence: No credential-holding or teach-back criteria.
